Hi team,

I drafted the scoped removal checklist for a single-thread excision. Key points below (attaching PDF checklist):

- Validate scope: map external timestamp to internal conversation_id. We must get a 1:1 match before any destructive action.
- Quarantine: mark the conversation as excluded from telemetry and dashboards immediately (non-destructive flag).
- Execution window: perform the excision during a low-traffic window — target today 14:00-14:30 PST to avoid race conditions.
- Removal action: delete the conversation node from the audit index, remove any KV cache entries, and scrub generated logs referencing the conversation_id.
- Backups: note that cold backups and weekly snapshots are immutable for a rolling retention period (45 days). We will redact references in the index and active backups where possible but must document remaining snapshot exposure in the removal report.
- Artifacts: signed removal_report-TGT-7129.pdf, operation log (hashed), and ticket closure entry.

Risk notes: full elimination from all backup tiers may require a separate data-retention exception and coordination with infra for snapshot rekeying or targeted erasure — we should surface that to the customer in the report.

Attaching: removal_checklist-TGT-7129.pdf (internal), example removal_report template.
